visual.detail: Manager must inspect all views for placement, proportions, missing/extra parts and visible intersections
visual.observation: Iso: one open tray, four raised corner ledges at the inside corners, side walls dropped to a sill along each span, and an 8x8 field of blind square pockets in the chequer pattern with the plan corner chamfers visible at every diagonal junction. Two half-disc orientation marks sit on the board margin, one per side, tangent to the edge rank. Top: the flat-shaded plan gives no tone difference between the board floor and the pocket floors, which is the renderer's known limitation and not a geometry defect; the pocket outlines and the two marks are visible. Front: the wall drops to the sightline sill with the corner piers standing proud, and the bottom sits flat on the bed. Nothing misplaced, missing, extra or intersecting; byte-identical to the frozen archive design.
